Why now

SEO has changed: 2022 vs. 2026.

What used to work now gets penalised. What wins today is architecture: entities, expertise, and user experience.

The old world (2022)

  • Focus on keyword density
  • Buying directory links in bulk
  • Walls of text to manipulate rankings
  • Traffic as the main success metric

The new reality (2026)

  • Semantic entities & relevance
  • Digital PR & earned editorial links
  • E-E-A-T: demonstrable clinical expertise
  • Speed that users feel (INP < 200ms)
  • Authority, user behaviour & conversion rates
The offer

Two engines. One growth system.

Local SEO builds the asset that compounds month after month. Paid ads bring patients through the door while it grows. Together, they cover the entire journey.

ENGINE 01 — THE ASSET

Local SEO Domination

  • Complete Google Business Profile build-out
  • Technical & on-page SEO for every service
  • Review engine: fresh, specific reviews weekly
  • Local authority: citations, E-E-A-T, backlinks
  • Topical authority content clusters
  • Conversion optimisation — traffic into bookings
  • 49-point Maps ranking radar, tracked monthly
ENGINE 02 — THE ACCELERATOR

Paid Ads Engine

  • Google Ads: high-intent local search campaigns
  • Meta Ads: demand creation + retargeting
  • Dedicated, conversion-built landing pages
  • Clean tracking: Pixel, Conversions API, GA4
  • Audiences built from real engagement signals
  • Weekly optimisation on actual cost-per-booking
  • Perfect for launching brand-new services fast
Why both: Ads deliver bookings from day one and generate the data (keywords, audiences, offers) that makes the SEO sharper. SEO steadily lowers your dependence on ad spend. Most clients start with both, then shift budget from ads to profit as organic takes over.

The 10-phase blueprint — built like a building.

Three levels, ten phases. Every level carries the one above it — no shortcuts that get you penalised.

1 · Google Business Profile & Tech SEO2 · Local Authority3 · Review Management

Every level carries the one above — built like a building, not a checklist.

Level 1 — The Foundation
1 Google Business Profile & Tech SEO Give Google absolute clarity: who, what, where
Google Business Profile (highest priority)
  • Primary category
  • Secondary categories
  • Every service listed
  • Service descriptions
  • Business description
  • Products (if applicable)
  • Opening hours
  • Appointment URL
  • FAQ
  • Attributes
  • Photos & videos
  • Practitioner profiles
  • Regular Google Posts
Website technical SEO
  • Core Web Vitals
  • Mobile optimisation
  • SSL
  • Schema
  • Sitemap & robots
  • Internal links
  • Crawl errors
  • Image optimisation
  • Page speed
The 2026 standard: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) under 200ms. INP measures the full latency from tap to visual response — heavy JavaScript blocks the main thread and frustrates patients mid-booking.
2 Local Authority Google loves entities
Location pages — one unique page per city/suburb served, never duplicated content.

Practitioner pages — every practitioner gets:
  • Biography
  • Experience
  • Qualifications
  • Services
  • Reviews
  • Internal links
E-E-A-T signals, placed visibly:
  • Certifications
  • Experience
  • Memberships
  • Awards
  • Media mentions
  • Publications
  • Speaking engagements
3 Reviews One of the biggest ranking factors today
  • Continuous review generation
  • Reviews mentioning treatments
  • Reviews mentioning location
  • Owner replies to every review
  • Fresh reviews every week
Specific context beats generic praise by miles: "Dr. Sarah helped my chronic shoulder pain in Bondi." ★★★★★  vs.  "Great clinic." — and owner replies are an active engagement signal.
Level 2 — The Trust Engine
4 Relevant Citations Class over mass
  • Apple Maps
  • Bing Places
  • Yelp
  • Facebook
  • Health directories
  • Local chamber of commerce
  • Industry associations
Absolute consistency of Name · Address · Phone everywhere.
5 Backlinks via Digital PR 1 editorial link > 50 directory links
Bought bulk links mean low domain authority, high penalty risk — and zero relevance for AI answer machines. Instead, we earn links through:
  • Local newspapers
  • Universities
  • Health blogs
  • Podcasts
  • Sponsorships
  • Associations
  • Suppliers
  • Guest articles
Strong earned links massively reinforce E-E-A-T — and push AI models to cite you as the primary source.
6 Topical Authority The biggest SEO advantage today
Instead of one page about a service, we build clusters — dedicated sub-pages for every specific condition, all logically interlinked, until every patient question is answered (semantic coverage):
Physiotherapy ├── Neck Pain ├── Sciatica ├── Back Pain ├── Tennis Elbow ├── Shoulder Pain ├── Frozen Shoulder ├── Knee Pain ├── Post-Surgery Rehab ├── Sports Injury ├── Headaches
Level 3 — The Authority Multiplier
7 Behaviour Signals Google watches everything
High click-through rates, long time on page and low bounce rates signal relevance. Interactions — calls, direction requests, photo views — are strong local ranking factors. The loop we optimise:
Impression→Click rate (CTR)→Time on page→Interaction (calls/directions)→Booking
8 Profile Engagement An active profile wins — weekly duty
  • New photos
  • Offers
  • Practice updates
  • Q&A curation
  • Review replies
9 Conversion Optimisation SEO traffic is worthless without booked appointments
The booking journey must be frictionless:
Landing on the page→Frictionless info (FAQs, trust badges)→Direct contact (sticky button, WhatsApp)→Appointment confirmed
  • Clear, omnipresent CTAs (sticky buttons)
  • WhatsApp & seamless online booking tools
  • Practitioner photos, case studies, trust badges
  • Specific FAQs that clear final doubts right on the page
10 Measurement & KPIs Data-driven decisions, not gut feeling
Monthly tracking of the metrics that map to real business growth — see the dashboard section below.

+ The AI Layer (Generative Engine Optimization)

Patients increasingly discover clinics through AI assistants. Google and LLMs reward content that delivers structured answers to real patient questions — and ignore unstructured walls of text.

FAQ blocksSchema / JSON-LDClean H1/H2 structure
→
ChatGPT · Gemini · AI Overviewsextract structured answers & cite the source
✕ Unstructured walls of text — ignored by AI answer machines
  • Structured data & schema (JSON-LD)
  • BLUF format: bottom line up front
  • E-E-A-T & author transparency
  • Frictionless AI extraction
  • AI visibility scans: ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews & AI Mode — same grid methodology as Maps
  • Tracked monthly, next to your Maps rankings
Priorities

The 80/20 — the target zone of highest ROI.

Maximum impact, minimum wasted effort. If we had to focus only on what moves the needle most:

Optimise the Google Business Profile completely — categories, services, description, photos, FAQs, posts.
A dedicated, high-quality page for every core service — with strong local optimisation and schema.
A consistent flow of genuine reviews — mentioning treatments and locations.
Topical authority — publish the content patients actually search for.
Conversion rate — more visitors become bookings, same traffic.
A handful of high-quality local backlinks — trusted organisations, not link volume.
Track rankings, calls, bookings, conversions — data over assumptions.
